title: Genomic DNA Removal and Total RNA Purification from Lysate
author: Bioline
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f48bqzw
materials: ISOLATE II Genomic DNA Removal Column
Discard the column with the bound genomic DNA.
Reassemble the spin column with its Collection Tube.

steps.title: Assemble DNA removal column
steps.instruction: Assemble an ISOLATE II Genomic DNA Removal Column (blue ring) with the provided collection tube, confirming the column has a blue ring.

steps.title: Load lysate onto DNA column
steps.instruction: Apply up to 600 µL of lysate to the column and centrifuge 1 min at 14,000 × g. Inspect the column; if any lysate remains, centrifuge an additional minute at 14,000 × g.

steps.title: Collect flow‑through
steps.instruction: Transfer the flow‑through to a sterile RNase‑free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and keep it on ice or at –20 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Add ethanol to flow‑through
steps.instruction: To every 100 µL of flow‑through, add 60 µL of 96‑100 % ethanol (e.g., 200 µL flow‑through → 120 µL ethanol) and mix by vortexing.

steps.title: Assemble RNA column
steps.instruction: Assemble an ISOLATE II RNA Column (black ring) with its provided collection tube, confirming the black ring.

steps.title: Load ethanolic lysate onto RNA column
steps.instruction: Apply up to 600 µL of the ethanolic lysate to the RNA column and centrifuge 1 min at ≥3,500 × g. Verify complete flow‑through; if incomplete, centrifuge an additional minute at 14,000 × g. Repeat loading steps as needed for the total lysate volume.

steps.title: Optional on‑column DNase I treatment
steps.instruction: If required for sensitive applications, perform on‑column DNase I digestion using the supplied DNase I according to the kit’s optional protocol.

steps.title: First RNA column wash
steps.instruction: Apply 400 µL Wash Buffer W1 to the RNA column, centrifuge 1 min at 14,000 × g, ensure all buffer passes through, discard the flow‑through, and re‑assemble the spin column with its collection tube.

steps.title: Second RNA column wash
steps.instruction: Repeat: apply 400 µL Wash Buffer W1, centrifuge 1 min at 14,000 × g, verify complete passage, discard flow‑through, and re‑assemble the column with its collection tube.

steps.title: Third RNA column wash
steps.instruction: Repeat: apply 400 µL Wash Buffer W1, centrifuge 1 min at 14,000 × g, verify complete passage, discard flow‑through, and re‑assemble the column with its collection tube.

steps.title: Dry RNA column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the assembled column for 2 min at 14,000 × g to dry it thoroughly, then discard the collection tube.

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Place the RNA column into a fresh 1.7 mL elution tube and add 50 µL RNA Elution Buffer directly onto the column matrix.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 2 min at 200 × g, then 1 min at 14,000 × g. Record the volume of eluate collected.

steps.title: Complete elution if needed
steps.instruction: If any eluate remains on the column, spin an additional 1 min at 14,000 × g. For maximal recovery, optionally repeat the addition of 50 µL Elution Buffer and the elution spin (steps 12‑14).

steps.title: Store purified RNA
steps.instruction: Store the isolated RNA at –20 °C for a few days or at –80 °C (recommended) for long‑term storage.
